fixRound: Round 2 (post-review fixes applied, re-rendered and re-verified)
round1Verdict: fix (score 52) — all blocker/major/minor findings addressed this round

rtlDecisions.action: Mirrored the complete doodle layer with scaleX(-1) (kept from round 1)
rtlDecisions.why: The doodle depicts a UI window, sidebar, divider, avatar column and message lines; these are layout-order semantics in an RTL product interface. Mirroring the complete layer preserves exact wobble geometry, seeds, boil and timing while moving the sidebar to the right.

rtlDecisions.action: Applied direction: rtl to the panel, retained the original child order, kept the sidebar as a fixed-width flex child (kept from round 1)
rtlDecisions.why: RTL flex flow places the sidebar on the right and the main content on the left without changing panel coordinates or animation timing.

rtlDecisions.what: Message row avatar and text order
rtlDecisions.action: direction: rtl on both skeleton and content rows so the avatar sits at the right edge and message text starts at the right, flush under the name (kept from round 1)
rtlDecisions.why: Avatar/text pairing follows reading and scan order in an RTL message list. Vertical row order is unchanged (chronological axis, not reading axis).

rtlDecisions.what: FIX (round-1 blocker): message line bidi order and alignment
rtlDecisions.action: Message line now uses faText(27, {unicodeBidi:'normal', textAlign:'start'}) instead of faText's plaintext default
rtlDecisions.why: The message line is built entirely from inline-block word spans, which are bidi-neutral; a unicodeBidi:'plaintext' paragraph with no strong characters resolves LTR, laying the words out left-to-right in the wrong reading order and flush left, far from the avatar. unicodeBidi:'normal' makes the line inherit direction:rtl from FaRoot and textAlign:'start' right-aligns it. Verified at f88/f95/f110/f142/f160/f171: words read right-to-left (صبح بخیر! امروز بازطراحی را شروع می‌کنیم) and the line sits under the name beside the avatar, mirroring the original composition.

rtlDecisions.action: Each Persian word is a joined word span animated with the original wordAt beats (row*13 stagger, 2.5-frame word stagger, +14-frame delayed last word of row 4); whitespace tokens kept as real text nodes, and the round-1 marginInlineEnd:9 was REMOVED so word gaps come from whitespace only
rtlDecisions.why: Keeps the word-level opacity/rise and identical timing without splitting Persian letters or breaking contextual joining; the margin fix removes the double spacing (whitespace token + 9px margin ≈ 40px gaps) so line density matches the original.

The zoom drifts toward the content area on the reading side of the window; after the RTL layout flip the content column is on the LEFT, so an unmirrored 58% origin pushed the crop onto the header/content while the dark sidebar stayed fully in frame, flipping the composition's emphasis. Verified at f142/f160/f171: the right-hand sidebar is cropped and the message column fills the frame, mirroring the original.

rtlDecisions.action: Digits wrapped in <bdi dir="ltr"> followed by ' ق.ظ' in DOM order, inside a span with unicodeBidi:'normal'
rtlDecisions.why: Makes the order deterministic instead of relying on bidi heuristics: in the RTL paragraph the isolated digit run sits to the RIGHT of ق.ظ, so reading right-to-left gives the time first, then the morning marker (۹:۰۱ ق.ظ), the Persian convention; the bdi also guarantees digit/colon order inside the time.

rtlDecisions.action: Mock names آنا، بن، کای، میا; idiomatic messages (عالیه، ارائه، صورتی‌اش، می‌شود with ZWNJ) (kept from round 1)
rtlDecisions.why: Natural Persian product-chat copy; length differences do not shift any beat (f95/f142 show the same revealed-word counts as the original at the same frames).

newLessons: faText()'s unicodeBidi:'plaintext' is only safe when the paragraph contains strong RTL characters directly in its text flow. A line built entirely from inline-block (bidi-neutral) spans resolves to LTR under plaintext: words end up in the wrong visual order and the line flushes left. For such lines override to unicodeBidi:'normal' (+ textAlign:'start') so the line inherits direction:rtl from FaRoot.
